title: Water Pressure Drop Transient Count
app: Flo by Moen, Rachio, Flume, Maytronics Dolphin, pool sensors, water softener sensors, and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=waterpressure:reading
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count(eval(pressure_psi<30)) as low_pressure_events by zone _time
| where low_pressure_events>0
| sort - low_pressure_events
description: Uses Water-pressure sensors telemetry to monitor how often water pressure drops below a healthy floor in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for pump or plumbing issues before they become user-visible, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Water-pressure sensors data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily zone table of low-pressure events.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how often water pressure drops below a healthy floor so you can spot pump or plumbing issues before they become user-visible before it becomes annoying.
